tasks.label: build WaviateScript Standalone Release|x64
args: $vswhere = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'; if (!(Test-Path $vswhere)) { throw 'vswhere.exe was not found. Install Visual Studio 2026 or Build Tools with MSBuild.' }; $msbuild = & $vswhere -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find 'MSBuild\**\Bin\amd64\MSBuild.exe' | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $msbuild) { $msbuild = & $vswhere -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find 'MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe' | Select-Object -First 1 }; if (-not $msbuild) { throw 'MSBuild.exe was not found by vswhere.' }; $buildArgs = @('Builds\VisualStudio2026\WaviateScript_StandalonePlugin.vcxproj', '/t:Build', '/p:Configuration=Release;Platform=x64'); for ($attempt = 1; $attempt -le 3; $attempt++) { & $msbuild @buildArgs; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { exit 0 }; if ($attempt -lt 3) { Write-Host "MSBuild failed on attempt $attempt. Retrying in 2 seconds..."; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 } }; exit $LASTEXITCODE
